nonBlockingFindings.finding: Diff-budget metric ambiguity on the contested file. `git diff --stat apps/api/services/identity_resolver.py` reports `11 insertions(+), 5 deletions(-)` — 11 changed/touched lines, but 16 if the two numbers are summed. The plan's own arithmetic is touched-line based (N3 calls the D5 return-set '6 touched lines'), and 11 <= 12 on that basis. Recorded rather than resolved by reshaping the code, because D4 explicitly forbids reshaping the D-A fix to fit a smaller number.

The service-decision half is proven there; the DB-enforcement half is proven by the Hybrid gates and by additional integration legs added for the same criteria (test_accrued_partial_unique_index_exists_and_blocks_second_credit, test_second_day_resolve_mints_no_second_credit_in_db, test_same_day_duplicate_collapses_to_one_event). Net coverage is strictly greater than the plan required; the split is disclosed in both files' docstrings.
